overview_description.description:
Edexy is an online interactive directory platform for discovering and rating local and online businesses.
Users can search Edexy via its website or with the official Edexy apps on iOS and Android smart devices.
Users can use Edexy platform for finding business information about private and public companies. 
Edexy information includes Addresses, contact information and business description, founding members and individuals in leadership positions, news, and events.
